question_sentence: A continuous round-the-world cruise abruptly ended after more than two years at sea. Why was the voyage cut short?
evidence: A residential cruise ship that has been sailing around the world for more than two years has evicted passengers after the Iran war drove fuel prices too high to continue its voyage.

question_sentence: Which MLB team won the World Series this week?
evidence: The Milwaukee Brewers won their first World Series title in franchise history, defeating the Tampa Bay Rays on Wednesday to complete a 4-1 series victory.

question_sentence: Israel held high-stakes elections this week. Which of the following is the name of its parliament?
evidence: Israel’s 120-seat parliament is known as the Knesset. By late Thursday, neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his main rival, ex-military chief Gadi Eisenkot, had received enough votes to reach a governing majority.

question_sentence: Which state has two candidates named Dan Sullivan running for the US Senate in the midterm elections?
evidence: Voters in Alaska are seeing two Senate candidates named Dan Sullivan on their midterm ballots. The state’s Republican governor has ordered an investigation into allegations that Democrats recruited a candidate with the same name as the GOP incumbent to confuse voters.

question_sentence: Which country was rocked by a deadly high-speed train collision this week?
evidence: Dozens were killed in a crash in Spain that authorities say was caused by both a computer system failure and apparent human error.

question_sentence: A convicted murderer escaped from prison this week, prompting a multi-state manhunt. Where did the escape occur?
evidence: The search for a convicted murderer who escaped from a Tennessee prison has crossed state lines after authorities found his stolen getaway truck in Illinois.

question_sentence: Which musician is set to headline the 2027 Super Bowl halftime show?
evidence: Rapper and entrepreneur Jay-Z announced he’ll perform at February’s Super Bowl LXI halftime show.

question_sentence: A rare skeleton sold for $47.3 million at auction this week. What type of fossil was it?
evidence: A skeleton of Nanotyrannus, a smaller T. rex relative, sold at Sotheby’s in New York for $47.3 million, becoming the second most valuable fossil ever.

question_sentence: Which band recently held a free concert at the National Mall in Washington, DC?
evidence: The hardcore band Turnstile played to tens of thousands of people in the shadow of the Washington Monument.
